description: This file defines the AlarmStorage class, responsible for saving, retrieving, and deleting Alarm instances using Android's SharedPreferences as storage. It handles version-specific storage considerations and provides methods for managing alarm data within the app.

classes.name: AlarmStorage
classes.description: Manages alarms persisted in SharedPreferences, including saving, retrieving, and deleting alarms, with considerations for Android version-specific storage handling.

methods.name: AlarmStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing SharedPreferences storage, possibly migrating preferences for Android N and above.

methods.name: saveAlarm
methods.description: Creates and stores a new Alarm instance with specified time parameters, returning the Alarm object.

methods.name: getAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves all stored alarms as a Set.

methods.name: deleteAlarm
methods.description: Removes a specified Alarm from storage by matching its ID.
